question: Should trusted node-host plugin commands become model-visible tools under existing node pairing and command policy, using the guarded design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90431?
rationale: The implementation is viable and has real proof, but accepting a new node-to-model execution surface and permanent protocol and SDK contracts requires maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Approve guarded exposure
options.body: Refresh the candidate and land it after confirming Gateway descriptor validation, command policy, stale-session checks, provenance, naming, and lifecycle cleanup as the permanent contract.

options.title: Retain generic node invocation
options.body: Reject model-visible node-hosted tools and keep plugins or the generic nodes tool as the supported integration route.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded exposure
recommendation.body: Refresh the candidate and land it after confirming Gateway descriptor validation, command policy, stale-session checks, provenance, naming, and lifecycle cleanup as the permanent contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the canonical implementation candidate and hold the strongest recent design, source-history, and proof context for this decision.
